Where it sits
—You already run the claims. This is the checking step inside them.
—It runs behind your platform. The client stays yours.
—Your payout rails and your client relationship do not change.
What it does
—Validates each claim against that campaign's rules.
—Captures every field off the document: products, quantities, prices, the full basket and any competitor.
—Reads retail receipts and trade invoices alike. The sample ahead is a vet invoice, which is the harder of the two.
